summary.zh: 用六个问题砍掉多余路线与功能
summary.en: Stress-test a roadmap, a PMF claim, or a decision to kill a feature.

description.zh: 在承诺季度路线图、上线新产品线，或一次加太多功能之前，用六个问题检查用户任务、北极星指标、PMF 信号、RICE 排序和机会成本。也用于反驳 PMF 已经成立的结论。
description.en: Six questions cover the job to be done, the north star metric, PMF signal, RICE rank, and what gets cut if this ships. Use it before a roadmap commitment, and to push back on a PMF claim or a feature kill.
